metadata.title: Optimal Average Distortion for Non-Expansive Embeddings of Euclidean Metrics into the Line: With applications to cut-matching games and vertex expansion
metadata.abstract: We show that any $n$-point Euclidean metric admits a non-expansive embedding into the line with average distortion at most $O\left(\sqrt{\frac{\log n}{\log\log n}}\right)$, matching a known lower bound. We also present two applications of this result. First, we give a cut-player strategy with an optimal spectral guarantee for the undirected cut-matching game. Second, we give an improved spectral approximation for vertex expansion in high-degree graphs.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: Euclid 有限度量到直线的最优平均畸变
analysis.workSummary: 证明任意 n 点 Euclid 度量可非扩张地映到直线，平均畸变至多为 O(√(log n/log log n))，与已知下界匹配。由此给无向 cut-matching game 的 cut-player 一个谱保证最优的策略，并改进高次图的顶点扩张谱近似。
techniques: 有限 Euclid 度量的非扩张映射
analysis.breakthrough: 在平均畸变尺度上达到最优阶，并把度量嵌入工具转化为图算法保证。
analysis.limitations: 平均畸变控制不等于每对距离的 bi-Lipschitz 控制，也不意味着映射必单射；最优是渐近阶，摘要未给常数和小 n 约定。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
